```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
view(penguins)
```

```{r}
penguins|>
  count(bill_length_mm)
```

```{r}
penguins|>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = species, y = bill_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Species by Bill length",
       x = "Species",
       y = "Bill Length")

```
